about: Production: each firm makes its output with a Cobb-Douglas recipe, q = tfp * levels^(1-sum of exponents) * product of factor^exponent. raw: producers bound to a world, placed by terrain (terrains.json). processing: firms every system has. Food and water are made two ways: simply (vertical farms and water reclaimers, which pull water from air and waste, on every world), enough to keep a few billion alive on each; or in protein foundries and comet harvesters, very productive but run on imported water and fabricators, which only trade keeps going. Freight, the transport between systems, burns aether: a system with none can receive goods but can't send any.
